title: Living Mirror Theory
definition: The idea that the project should evolve like the very systems it studies, becoming a living mirror of life's complexity and intricacy.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine the project as a mirror that learns and grows just like us. The more we use it, the better it becomes at understanding and reflecting our world.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The project should adopt a living mirror theory approach, meaning it should continually evolve and adapt to replicate the complex systems it studies. This ensures its accuracy and usefulness.
difficulty_levels.expert: The living mirror theory allows the project to be a perpetual learner, adapting and growing to mimic the intricate patterns and behaviors of the world. This not only enhances its usefulness but also adds to the philosophy of science as it challenges the traditional distinction between observer and observed.

extra_fields.insight: The project's evolution should mirror the complexity of life, making it a dynamic and evolving tool that learns and grows alongside its users.
